replay.host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 logical CPUs, 16 GiB, Node v24.21.0, linux
replay.note: readPackage (src/pool/v3/package-reader.ts) over the operator journal's served package: decode, evidence store (in memory), terms and checkpoint signatures, the fixture venue's records, each statement's state transition (spent set, note tree appends in host Poseidon2, delivery) and receipts. Proof verification is excluded: stand-in proofs of the configuration's length, judged by a stub (first byte = kind). Venue reads are in-memory fixture answers, no network. Per statement = read / (1 issue + N spends).

verify-root.host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 logical CPUs, 16 GiB, Node v24.21.0, linux

threads4.note: The proof is a genuine pool-v3 spend (scripts/pool/aggregation-probe/proofs/spend.proof). An aggregation root is an UltraHonk noir-recursive proof of the same 458 fields (14,656 bytes) verified the same way with 2 public inputs, so its verification costs the same. startBackend/openV3Verifier load 2^15 points and derive six keys, which a verify-only phone with pinned keys skips: its cost is pinned.instanceStartMs + one verification.
